name: release-guard
description: Release gate (APP_V, WHATS_NEW, LOG, helper, files; the Android app's release counter, what's-new, LOG line and android-check), keystores never committed, gh pr merge checked like the merge tool, house-rule checks on index.html edits, past-fix lookups from docs/LOG.md, test-before-done checks (browser for index.html, Gradle for android/), and a notice when a merge is live on GitHub Pages or android-vN is released.
